description: This source file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in Orleans.Hosting to configure Azure Table Storage-based reminder storage. It provides methods to set up reminder storage via different configuration options, including direct connection strings and delegate-based configurations.

classes.name: AzureStorageReminderSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Azure Table Storage reminders.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for reminders, with a delegate to configure options.
